# 1. Load libraries and subset the data

Zoe list | UVP station id
"Keb/TCA-S3" | "keb_S03"  (also TCA_S3?)
"TCAT3-08" | "TCA_T3_08"
"TCA-BB2" | "TCA_BB2"
"TCAT3-17"| "TCA_T3_17"

No UVP6 profiles for: 
"TCAT6-07" -> TCAT6-04/05/06
"TCAT1-05" -> TCA_T3_05?

ALSO: RA27 has no Calanus spp in the dataset
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

station.list <- c("RA27","RA41","RA52","RA62",
                  "keb_S03","TCA_T3_08","TCA_BB2","TCA_T3_17",
                  "TCAT6-07","TCAT1-05")
```

## Curate the datasets
```{r, eval=FALSE}
# The calculated trait values
load("data/uvp6_images_calculated_traits_20260317.RData")

# Profiles metadata with regions and dataframe of volumes at 5m bins
load("data/UVP6_Calanus_metadata_20260129.RData")


df.meta <- Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  filter(Year == 2024) %>% 
  filter(sample_stationid %in% station.list ) %>% 
  select(sample_id, sample_stationid, 
         nCalanusImages, nimages,
         sample_cruise:object_time,
         Year:n5mbins) %>% 
  # Note 2 casts are much shallower than bottom depth... remove?
  filter(castratio > 0.1)

# Note that this includes "Calanus spp" and large copepoda/calanoida >3 mm major axis length
df.copepods <- indiv_traits %>% 
  filter(sample_id %in% df.meta$sample_id) %>% 
  # Filter only Calanus spp?
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  # filter only abundance and the calculated total individual biomass
  select(taxa, object_id, object_annotation_category,
         sample_stationid = Site, 
         Cruise, sample_id, object_depth_max,
         Major, Minor,
         prosome_length_mm,
         prosome_total_mgC) %>% 
  # Assign 5m depth bin based on object observation depth
  mutate(Depth_5m = floor(object_depth_max/5)*5 + 2.5 ) %>% 
  
  # Add column of the volume sampled in 5m depth bins from metadata
  left_join(volumes.df, 
            by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_5m)) 

# Export data for quick loading
save(df.copepods, df.meta, volumes.df,
     file = "data/Zoe_uvp6_calanus_20260319.RData")
```

# 2. Calculate abundance and biomass profiles
The data frame of individuals needs to be converted to the abundance and biomass concentrations. The UVP6 data assigns the volume of water sampled in 5 m bins. According to Barth and Stone (2022), the minimum depth bin size for stable concentration estimates is 20 m. Here we can start to explore the data by setting a bin size of 100m, that value can be adjusted if preferred.

Note that some stations can have multiple profiles. For these instances, the profiles are averaged by depth layer. Alternatively, values can be pooled but the resulting estimated concentrations will be similar (Barth and Stone, 2022).
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Open the file of extracted data
load("data/Zoe_uvp6_calanus_20260319.RData")

# Set the size of the depth layers
binsize <- 100 

# Calculate the abundance and biomass in 5 m bins (minimum vertical resolution)
df.5m <- df.copepods %>% 
  # Calculate total abundance and biomass per 5m bin. Note that this is not yet by volume
  group_by(sample_stationid, sample_id, Depth_5m) %>% 
  summarise(abundance = n(),
         biomass_mgC = sum(prosome_total_mgC),
         .groups = "drop") 

# There will be bins sampled by the UVP but with no copepods. This script will fill in the "blank" depth bins when no Calanus were observed.
df.5m.zero <-  volumes.df %>% 
  filter(sample_id %in% df.5m$sample_id) %>% 
  select(-Sampled_volume_L) %>% 
  left_join(df.5m, 
            by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_5m)) %>% 
  # replace NA with 0
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>% 
  select(-sample_stationid)

# Get the total volume sampled for each depth layer in UVP6 profile.
sample.profiles <- df.5m.zero %>% 
  mutate(Depth_layer = floor(Depth_5m / binsize) * binsize) %>% 
  # Calculate concentrations per "binsize" m bin (note the number of 5m bins)
  group_by(sample_id, Depth_layer) %>% 
  summarise(n5mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            abundance = sum(abundance),
            biomass_mgC = sum(biomass_mgC),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # This is more ideal because averaging the 5m bin concentrations results in slightly different values because the sampled volume is different per 5m bin
  mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance/Sampled_volume_m3,
         biomass_mgC_m3 = biomass_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3) %>%
  # To calculate /m2 abundance and biomass by area, multiply by the depth of water sampled which is 5m * the number of 5m bins
  mutate(abundance_m2 = abundance_m3 * (5 * n5mbins),
         biomass_mgC_m2 = biomass_mgC_m3 * (5 * n5mbins)) %>% 
  # add station id info
  left_join(df.meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, sample_stationid), 
            by = "sample_id") 
  

# Average the concentrations for stations with multiple profiles
station.profiles <- sample.profiles %>% 
  group_by(sample_stationid, Depth_layer) %>% 
  summarise(nprofiles = n(),
            nimages = sum(abundance),
            across(c(abundance_m3:biomass_mgC_m2),
              mean, na.rm = TRUE), 
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  
  # For visualization purposes, recenter the depth layer
  mutate(Depth_layer = Depth_layer + (binsize / 2)) 


# To calculate the depth-integrated abundance and biomass of each UVP6 profile, simply sum the concentrations by area (m2).
profile.integ <- station.profiles %>% 
  group_by(sample_stationid) %>% 
  summarise(nimages = sum(nimages),
            total_abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2),
            total_biomass_mgC_2 = sum(biomass_mgC_m2),
            .groups = "drop")

rm(df.5m, df.5m.zero)
```


# 3. Plot vertical distribution
```{r profiles}
clrs <- c("blue1", "red", "deeppink1","purple2","black",
          "orange2", "brown", "forestgreen")

# Abundance profiles for each UVP6 cast, organized by station
ggplot(sample.profiles %>% 
  mutate(Depth_layer = Depth_layer + (binsize / 2)) ,
             aes(x = Depth_layer, y = biomass_mgC_m3,
                 color = sample_stationid,
                 group = sample_id)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_reverse(breaks = seq(0, 2400, 200), expand = c(0.05,0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01,0.01)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = clrs) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  xlab("Depth (m)") + ylab("Abundance (indiv m-3)") +
  facet_wrap(~sample_stationid, nrow = 2)


# Abundance concentration (# m-3) profiles for station averages
ggplot(station.profiles,
             aes(x = Depth_layer, y = biomass_mgC_m3,
                 fill = sample_stationid)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  # # if marking the bottom depth
  # geom_vline(data = df.meta, 
  #            aes(xintercept = bottom_depth_m), color = "black") +
  scale_x_reverse(breaks = seq(0, 2400, 200), expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01,0.01)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clrs) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  xlab("Depth (m)") + ylab("Abundance (indiv m-3)") +
  facet_wrap(~sample_stationid, nrow = 2)

# Biomass concentration (mg C m-3) profiles for station averages
ggplot(station.profiles,
             aes(x = Depth_layer, y = abundance_m3,
                 fill = sample_stationid)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_reverse(breaks = seq(0, 2400, 200), expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01,0.01)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clrs) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  xlab("Depth (m)") + ylab("Biomass (mg C m-3)") +
  facet_wrap(~sample_stationid, nrow = 2)

```

## Map sites
```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(ggOceanMaps)
library(ggspatial)

# Prepare the map
basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = TRUE, glaciers = FALSE,
        limits = c(-87,-53,70,81), rotate = T,
        legends = TRUE, land.col = "ivory",  bathy.style = "poly_grays",
        land.border.col = "black", gla.border.col = NA) +
  # Plot the points
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = df.meta %>% 
                                  filter(sample_stationid %in% 
                                           df.copepods$sample_stationid),
                                aes(x = object_lon, y = object_lat,
                                    color = sample_stationid),
                                size = 3,
                                alpha = 1) +
  # Plot the labels
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_text_repel(data = df.meta %>% 
                                       distinct(sample_stationid,
                                                .keep_all = TRUE)%>% 
                                  filter(sample_stationid %in% 
                                           df.copepods$sample_stationid),
                                aes(x = object_lon, y = object_lat,
                                    label = sample_stationid,
                                    color = sample_stationid)) +
  # Improve the visuals
  scale_color_manual(values = clrs) +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = c(0.88, 0.75)) +
  guides(color = "none") 
        
```
